notes.title: Vacation released!
notes.notes:
I've released my second game!

This is my first experience in creating enemy AI and my first experience in creating a shooter. I tried to make it as simple and fun as possible. Hope you like it)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265857/54af95d44c8e2c3116349ccfcb0efab2f4ee9bd9.png[/img]

And now I've started to create my third game, in which I use more complex tools.

Enjoy the game!
